body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-04-30 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "We will continue to target about 20% to 25% growth even on this elevated base." Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: +20-25% (FY25 base INR 4,624 cr -> INR 5,549-5,780 cr). Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: delivered. Evidence: FY26 revenue INR 5,552.8 cr = +20.1% (company; screener 5,553 vs 4,624). Bottom of the range.

body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2026-02-05 (Q3FY26 concall transcript): "Going forward, next couple of years, I expect the inflows to increase by at least 15%, 20% on an annualized basis" Metric: T&D order inflow growth. Target: +15-20% p.a. FY27-28. Deadline: 2028-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: withdrawn. Evidence: May-26 (prompted): FY27 T&D inflow 'INR 15,000 crores max', more likely 13,000-14,000; 'our order inflow on T&D might not grow at 20% ... or at 15%', explained as a choice to stay selective. Explanation given: selectivity, labour, 2.5-year order cover (prompted)
